tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.en: Breaks through matrix ranks. Hold your own Soul Stone, fill the offerings and start a trial
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.zh: 突破矩阵阶的台子。主手拿着绑定你的灵魂石，放好祭品，开一场试炼

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible..en: Sneak + use with your Soul Stone: put your UBMRU into the trial reserve
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible..zh: 拿着你的灵魂石潜行右键，把身上的 UBMRU 存进试炼储备

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.max.en: You are at the top rank

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.no_d.en: The next rank has no data
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.no_d.zh: 下一阶的数据没有读到

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.alig.en: Your matrix type changes when you take in unbalanced MRU. A Neutral matrix can't pass this rank
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.alig.zh: 矩阵属性随你吸进的失衡 MRU 改变，中性的矩阵过不了这一阶

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.site.en: Site: the crucible alone is enough
Soul Pentacle, tier %1$s or higher: ready
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.site.zh: 灵魂五芒星（%1$s 档以上）：就绪

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.site.en: Needs a finished Soul Pentacle (tier %1$s+) within 8 blocks
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.site.zh: 8 格内要有一座成形的灵魂五芒星（%1$s 档以上）

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.site.en: Pentacle tier too low: needs %1$s, best nearby is %2$s
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.site.zh: 五芒星档位不够：要 %1$s 档，附近最高 %2$s 档

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.site.en: Checking whether that pentacle is yours
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.site.zh: 正在确认这座五芒星归不归你
五芒星的 ESPE 不够：%3$s / %4$s

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.site.en: From Rank 4 on, a finished Soul Pentacle of your own, or one you may build at, has to stand within 8 blocks of the crucible. The ESPE comes out of its pillars
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.site.zh: 四阶起，淬炼台 8 格内要有一座成形的灵魂五芒星，是你自己的或者你能动的那座，ESPE 从它的柱子里扣

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.offe.en: Put each offering in its own slot by hand. They stay locked during the trial and are used up only if you win
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.offe.zh: 每项祭品各占一格，只能亲手放。试炼中格子锁住，成功了才消耗

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.ener.en: Sneak + use the crucible with your Soul Stone to move UBMRU into the reserve (up to %1$s). The reserve is spent first and isn't lost on death
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.ener.zh: 拿着你的灵魂石潜行右键淬炼台，把 UBMRU 存进试炼储备（最多 %1$s）。开始时先扣储备，死了也不丢

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.self.en: Hold a Soul Stone bound to you in your main hand
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.self.zh: 主手拿着绑定你的灵魂石

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.self.en: Stand within 3 blocks of the crucible

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.chan.zh: 和平难度：站着引导 %1$s 秒

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.chan.en: No Matrix Echoes appear. Stay within 3 blocks of the crucible without moving or getting hurt until the bar fills. Moving or taking damage starts it over
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.chan.zh: 不放矩阵回响。站在淬炼台 3 格内别动、别受伤，直到血条走满；动了或受伤就从头算

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.echo.zh: %2$s 秒内打倒 %1$s 只矩阵回响

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.echo.en: Up to %1$s at once, %2$s health, %3$s attack damage each. They only fight you, and only your hits hurt them
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.echo.zh: 同时最多 %1$s 只，每只生命 %2$s、攻击 %3$s。它们只打你，也只有你打得动它们

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.butt.en: Energy is paid when the trial starts. If you fail, it isn't returned and the offerings stay in their slots
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.butt.zh: 开始时扣能量；失败了能量不退，祭品留在格子里

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.rank.zh: 这一阶的数据没有读到
站点：%1$s 档灵魂五芒星

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: You are already at the top rank
The next rank has no data
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: 下一阶的数据没有读到

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: You are already in a trial
Someone else is in a trial at this crucible
You failed a trial not long ago. Wait out the cooldown
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: 刚失败过一次，等冷却结束

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: Hold a Soul Stone bound to you in your main hand
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: 主手要拿着绑定你的灵魂石

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: Stand within 3 blocks of the crucible
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: 要站在淬炼台 3 格内

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: Your Matrix Codex isn't there yet
No finished Soul Pentacle within 8 blocks
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: 8 格内没有成形的灵魂五芒星

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: The Soul Pentacle nearby is too low a tier
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: 附近的灵魂五芒星档位不够

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: The Soul Pentacle nearby isn't yours
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: 附近的灵魂五芒星不归你

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: Still checking whether the Soul Pentacle is yours. Try again in a moment
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: 还在确认五芒星归不归你，稍后再试

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: Not enough ESPE in the Soul Pentacle's pillars
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: 五芒星柱子里的 ESPE 不够

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: Not enough UBMRU, counting the trial reserve
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: UBMRU 不够（试炼储备算在内）

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: This rank needs more MRU than the Crucible can hold (machines.matrix_crucible.max_mru)
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: 这一阶要的 MRU 比淬炼台的容量还大，充不满（machines.matrix_crucible.max_mru）

gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.en: Not enough MRU in the crucible
gui.essentialcraft5.matrix_crucible.bloc.zh: 淬炼台里的 MRU 不够

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.no_.en: there's no open ground around the crucible for Matrix Echoes, or you can't build there
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.no_.zh: 淬炼台周围没有能放矩阵回响的空地，或者那里你动不了

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.spa.en: another mod or a plugin stopped the Matrix Echo from appearing
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.spa.zh: 矩阵回响被别的模组或插件拦下了，放不出来

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.roo.en: still checking whether you can build around the crucible, try again in a moment
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.roo.zh: 还在确认周围的地方你能不能动，稍后再点

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.pay.en: the energy was used up by something else just now

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.sta.en: Trial for %1$s: defeat %2$s Matrix Echoes within %3$s seconds
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.sta.zh: %1$s试炼开始，%3$s 秒内打倒 %2$s 只矩阵回响

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.sta.en: Channel for %1$s: stand still near the crucible for %2$s seconds
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.sta.zh: %1$s引导开始，在淬炼台旁边站着别动 %2$s 秒

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.bec.en: The difficulty went Peaceful and the Echoes faded. Stand still near the crucible for %1$s seconds instead
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.bec.zh: 难度变成了和平，回响散了。改成在淬炼台旁边站着别动 %1$s 秒

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.cha.en: Too far from the crucible. The channel starts over
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.cha.zh: 离淬炼台太远，引导从头算

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.cha.en: You were hurt. The channel starts over
You moved. The channel starts over

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.fai.en: Trial failed (%1$s). You can try again in %2$s seconds. The offerings are still in the crucible
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.fai.zh: 试炼失败（%1$s），%2$s 秒后才能再试，祭品还在淬炼台里

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.fai.en: Trial failed (%1$s). The offerings are still in the crucible
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.fai.zh: 试炼失败（%1$s），祭品还在淬炼台里

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.fai.en: Trial failed (%1$s). You can try again in %2$s seconds
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.fai.zh: 试炼失败（%1$s），%2$s 秒后才能再试

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.fai.en: you went too far from the crucible
the crucible or its offerings are gone

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.abo.en: The ground where the Matrix Echoes appeared is no longer yours to change, or another mod or a plugin keeps stopping them, so the trial stopped. The energy you paid is back
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.abo.zh: 回响出现过的地方你动不了了，或者回响被别的模组、插件拦着放不出来，试炼中止，扣掉的能量已经退回

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.abo.en: The ground where the Matrix Echoes appeared is no longer yours to change, or another mod or a plugin keeps stopping them, so the trial stopped. The energy went back, but the crucible or the pillars were full and some of it didn't fit
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.abo.zh: 回响出现过的地方你动不了了，或者回响被别的模组、插件拦着放不出来，试炼中止。能量退回去了，但淬炼台或柱子已经满了，有一部分没放下

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.en: Moved %1$s UBMRU into the trial reserve (%2$s / %3$s)
Matrix ranks are turned off, so the trial reserve isn't used
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.zh: 矩阵阶没有开启，用不上试炼储备

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.en: A trial is running. Save up after it ends
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.zh: 试炼正在进行，结束以后再存

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.en: Your next rank's requirements aren't loaded, so there is nothing to save for yet
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.zh: 下一阶的要求没有读到，先不用存

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.en: Your next rank takes no UBMRU. Nothing to save for
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.zh: 下一阶不要 UBMRU，不用存

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.en: Your trial reserve held more than your next rank needs. %1$s UBMRU went back to you
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.zh: 试炼储备超出了下一阶要的量，多出的 %1$s UBMRU 退回了你身上

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.en: You are at the top rank. Nothing left to save for
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.zh: 你已经到了最高阶，不用再存

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.en: You have no UBMRU to move (reserve %1$s / %2$s)
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.res.zh: 身上没有 UBMRU 可存（试炼储备 %1$s / %2$s）

bossbar.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.zh: 矩阵试炼 · %1$s · 回响 %2$s / %3$s · 剩 %4$s 秒

bossbar.essentialcraft5.matrix_trial.cha.zh: 矩阵引导 · %1$s · 还要站 %2$s 秒 · 时限剩 %3$s 秒
